resources.string: 44.1 kHz PCM synthesizer with <0.03 ms jitter. Tap \'KIT\' in the top right to cycle V90 Click, Woodblock, Rimshot, or Pure Sine.
Tap any numbered beat circle (1..12) to cycle between ACCENT (Coral), NORMAL (Cyan), SUB-ACCENT (Amber), and MUTE.
Drag the circular BPM ring, use the -5 / -1 / +1 / +5 step buttons, or tap \'TAP TEMPO\' repeatedly to match any live song\'s groove.
STEALTH DROP plays 4 full bars to lock in your timing, then randomly silences clicks to test your internal clock. SPEED TRAINER automatically steps up BPM every 4 bars (+2 / +4 / +5 BPM).
